nodes.title: SG-5.2 · Scene object entity with hover, label, click, actions and keyboard access
nodes.body:
Context: game/src/entities/SceneObject.ts only creates a sprite (key, position, scale, depth) and toggles visibility from visibleWhen. No interaction helper exists in game/src/systems yet. Desired behavior: every authored ObjectSpec becomes an interactive entity. Expected result: hover highlights the object and shows its name, a click or keyboard activation emits an event carrying the object id and its currently available actions. Why: interactive bedroom objects must be data-driven and keyboard accessible.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a pointer position inside an object's interactionBounds, When hit-tested, Then the helper reports a hit and a position outside reports a miss
- Given an object with actions guarded by conditions, When the state changes, Then only actions whose conditions pass are listed
- Given a pointer over the object, When hover starts and ends, Then highlight and name label toggle on and off
- Given a click or Enter/Space on a focused visible object, When activated, Then an interact event with the object id and available actions is emitted


## Scope
- In scope: New interaction helper in game/src/systems
- In scope: SceneObject hover, label, click, focus and activation
- In scope: RenderContext/RenderHandle interface extension
- In scope: buildScene focus cycling and interact callback
- Out of scope: Phaser-backed RenderContext implementation
- Out of scope: React ActionMenu changes
- Out of scope: New content or assets
- Preserve: ObjectSpec schema
- Preserve: Existing SceneObject sprite creation arguments and visibility sync
- Preserve: buildScene layer ordering


## Technical constraints
- Engine code stays free of Phaser imports; rendering goes through RenderContext
- Reuse evaluateAll from game/src/systems/conditions.ts


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered with Act and Verify units
- Unit tests green with fake render context


## Non-functional requirements
- Pure, deterministic helper functions


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Interaction helper provides hit-testing, available actions and activation keys
nodes.body:
Context: ObjectSpec carries interactionBounds (relative to position, scaled) and actions with conditions, but nothing evaluates them. Desired behavior: a pure helper exposes pointInBounds, availableActions, isActivationKey and nextFocusIndex. Expected result: SceneObject and buildScene reuse one tested helper. Why: the intent requires using an interaction helper.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given bounds {x:0,y:0,width:40,height:80}, position (100,200), scale 2, When point (110,210) is tested, Then it is a hit and (190,210) is a miss
- Given an object without interactionBounds, When point-tested, Then the result is a miss
- Given actions with and without failing conditions, When availableActions runs, Then only passing actions are returned in authored order
- Given keys Enter and ' ', When isActivationKey runs, Then true; for 'a' false
- Given count 3, index 2 and delta +1, When nextFocusIndex runs, Then 0; with count 0 it returns -1


## Scope
- In scope: game/src/systems/interaction.ts
- Out of scope: Rendering
- Out of scope: React UI
- Preserve: conditions.ts behavior


## Technical constraints
- No Phaser or DOM imports


## Definition of done
- Helper exported and typed against ObjectSpec


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · SceneObject renders bounds, hover highlight, name label and emits click
nodes.body:
Context: RenderHandle only has setVisible and destroy. Desired behavior: createSprite receives the object name and interaction bounds; the handle exposes setHighlighted, setLabelVisible, onHover and onClick. SceneObject toggles highlight and label on hover and emits an interact event on click, only when visible. Expected result: pointer interaction is data-driven with no Phaser in the entity. Why: hover and click identify and trigger interactive objects.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a spec with a name and bounds, When constructed, Then createSprite receives label equal to spec.name and the computed bounds
- Given hover enters then leaves, When callbacks fire, Then setHighlighted and setLabelVisible receive true then false
- Given a visible object is clicked, When onClick fires, Then the interact listener receives the object id and availableActions for the state
- Given the object is hidden by visibleWhen, When clicked or hovered, Then no event is emitted and no highlight shows


## Scope
- In scope: renderContext.ts interfaces
- In scope: SceneObject hover/click/onInteract
- Out of scope: Phaser implementation of RenderContext
- Preserve: Existing createSprite fields key,x,y,scale,depth
- Preserve: visibleWhen sync


## Technical constraints
- Reuse availableActions and pointInBounds from systems/interaction.ts


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Interfaces and entity updated


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Scene objects support keyboard focus and activation
nodes.body:
Context: no keyboard access exists. Desired behavior: SceneObject has focus() and blur() applying the same highlight and label as hover, and handleKey(key) that activates when focused and isActivationKey. buildScene-level SceneFocus helper cycles focus across visible objects using nextFocusIndex. Expected result: users can Tab/arrow to an object and press Enter or Space to open its actions. Why: interactive objects must be keyboard accessible.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a focused visible object, When Enter or Space is pressed, Then the interact event is emitted
- Given an unfocused object, When Enter is pressed, Then nothing is emitted
- Given three objects with the second hidden, When focus moves next twice from the first, Then focus lands on the third then wraps to the first
- Given focus moves away, When blur runs, Then highlight and label turn off


## Scope
- In scope: SceneObject focus/blur/handleKey
- In scope: focus cycling function in buildScene.ts
- Out of scope: DOM key listener binding
- Out of scope: Phaser input
- Preserve: buildScene return type and ordering


## Technical constraints
- Reuse isActivationKey and nextFocusIndex


## Dependencies
- REQ1
- REQ2


## Definition of done
- Focus and activation implemented


## Non-functional requirements
- Hidden objects are never focusable


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.description: Add pure functions pointInBounds, availableActions, isActivationKey and nextFocusIndex reusing evaluateAll.
acceptance_criteria: Module exports the four functions with typed signatures
availableActions uses evaluateAll on each action's conditions

steps.action: Create the file; export pointInBounds(spec: ObjectSpec, px: number, py: number): boolean returning false when spec.interactionBounds is undefined, else true when px and py lie within [position.x + b.x*scale, +b.width*scale] and [position.y + b.y*scale, +b.height*scale] inclusive of the left/top edge and exclusive of the right/bottom edge
steps.code: const b = spec.interactionBounds; if (!b) return false; const x0 = spec.position.x + b.x * spec.scale; const y0 = spec.position.y + b.y * spec.scale; return px >= x0 && px < x0 + b.width * spec.scale && py >= y0 && py < y0 + b.height * spec.scale;
steps.expected: Function compiles and returns booleans per the bounds rule

steps.action: Export availableActions(state: GameState, spec: ObjectSpec): ActionSpec[] returning spec.actions.filter(a => evaluateAll(state, a.conditions)); import evaluateAll from './conditions'
steps.expected: Only actions with passing conditions are returned

steps.action: Export isActivationKey(key: string): boolean returning true for 'Enter' and ' ' only
steps.expected: Returns true only for Enter and Space

steps.action: Export nextFocusIndex(count: number, current: number, delta: 1 | -1): number returning -1 when count <= 0, else ((current + delta) % count + count) % count
steps.code: if (count <= 0) return -1; return (((current + delta) % count) + count) % count;
steps.expected: Focus index wraps in both directions

nodes.description: Add focus API to SceneObject and a moveFocus helper exported from buildScene.ts.
acceptance_criteria: SceneObject.handleKey emits on Enter/Space when focused
moveFocus skips hidden objects and wraps

steps.lines: after activate method added in the previous unit
steps.action: Add private focused = false; focus(): if visible set focused true, setHighlighted(true), setLabelVisible(true); blur(): set focused false, setHighlighted(false), setLabelVisible(false); handleKey(key: string): if focused && isActivationKey(key) call this.activate(); add getters isVisible() and isFocused(); import isActivationKey from '../systems/interaction'
steps.expected: Focused objects activate on Enter and Space only

steps.action: Export moveFocus(objects: SceneObject[], delta: 1 | -1): void: collect visible = objects.filter(o => o.isVisible()); current = visible.findIndex(o => o.isFocused()); next = nextFocusIndex(visible.length, current, delta) (when current is -1 and delta is 1 start at 0 by using current = -1 so result is 0); blur all objects; if next >= 0 call visible[next].focus(); import nextFocusIndex from '../systems/interaction'
steps.code: const next = nextFocusIndex(visible.length, current, delta); objects.forEach((o) => o.blur()); if (next >= 0) visible[next].focus();
steps.expected: Focus advances over visible objects and wraps
